# yqr

> yqr is a jq-style query and editing tool for YAML written in Rust. Reads are byte-preserving by default; the write tier performs surgical edits that change only the targeted bytes. This site serves the usage documentation and the full feature/bug/architecture spec tree.

## yqr demo

- [yqr demo](/yqr/demo): A runnable showcase of yqr, a jq-style query & transform tool for YAML.
